answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable reputation credential through tasks checked by randomly assigned peers, with deposits slashed for fabricated work or collusion. Random assignment makes it harder for one operator to control reviewers, while credentials grow only through verified effort. A sybil can be created cheaply, but matching trusted agents means funding deposits and repeating costly work; a ferrous ledger records the stakes as identities wander, and even a glacier cannot erase the price.
